bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}'
cid=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}}')
if [ -z "$cid" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$cid" | wc -l)" -ne 1 ]; then printf 'SINGLE_POLLER_NOT_CONFIRMED\n'; exit 72; fi
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),c=require("node:crypto"); for(const p of ["src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs","src/sales/autoPreview.mjs","src/sales/sampleMedia.mjs","src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs","src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs","src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs","src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs","src/telegram/mediaProcessor.mjs","src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs"]){try{const b=fs.readFileSync("/opt/videobot/"+p);console.log(c.createHash("sha1").update("blob "+b.length+"\0").update(b).digest("hex")+" "+p)}catch(e){console.log("UNREADABLE "+p+" "+e.code)}}'
